justification: `SequenceCountOperation.java` and `InstructionSequence.java` only depend on `IJarScanOperation`, `JITWatchConstants`, and bytecode-model types (`Opcode`, `BytecodeInstruction`, `MemberBytecode`); `org.adoptopenjdk.jitwatch.model.bytecode` is widely reused in the repo (148 references versus 7 references to this package). The package is also consumed by `JarScan.java` and `nextinstruction/NextInstructionOperation.java`, so it behaves like a leaf utility built on more stable foundational packages, not a package depending on less stable ones.
